definition_zh: 腐殖质；土壤中充分腐解的深色有机物
definition_en: the dark, stable organic material in soil formed from fully decomposed plant and animal remains
core_image: 落叶层下抓起一把黑褐色松软的腐殖土，手指一捏便散成细屑
scene: 林地落叶层下面露出一层黑褐色的松软物质，抓一把在手里像海绵，雨水从指缝渗出，向导说 This humus holds water and keeps the forest floor cool.
sceneCN: 这里 humus 指「土壤中充分腐解的深色有机物」，取第 1 个义项（腐殖质本身）；句意为这层腐殖质能保住水分，让林地地表保持阴凉。图中可辨识物件：落叶层、黑褐色腐殖土、指缝、渗出的水。

pos.zh: 腐殖质（不可数，土壤学与园艺学用语）

forms.label: 相关形容词（已腐殖化的）

derivatives.zh: 腐殖的；与腐殖质有关的
腐殖化作用；有机物转变为腐殖质的过程
腐殖酸（腐殖质中可碱溶的组分）

senses.title: Stable dark organic matter in soil
senses.definition: the dark, finely decomposed organic fraction of soil that resists further rapid breakdown
senses.definitionCN: 土壤中深色、充分腐解、难以再快速分解的有机部分
senses.example: Humus gives the forest soil its dark colour and its smell.
senses.exampleCN: 腐殖质赋予林地土壤深色与气味。
senses.why: The Latin word for earth was applied to the earth-like end product of decay, so the name says what it looks like.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语表示「土地」的词被用来指腐解的最终产物，因此这个名字说的是它看起来像什么。

senses.title: Spongy, water-holding material
senses.definition: the physical behaviour of humus, holding several times its weight in water and keeping soil open
senses.definitionCN: 腐殖质的物理表现：能吸持自身重量数倍的水，并让土壤保持疏松
senses.example: Humus keeps the sandy bed moist long after watering.
senses.exampleCN: 浇水很久之后，腐殖质仍让砂质苗床保持湿润。
senses.why: Its crumb structure creates tiny pores, so water is held by surface tension rather than running straight through.
senses.whyCN: 它的团粒结构造出微小孔隙，因此水被表面张力留住，而不是直接流走。

senses.title: The humus layer
senses.definition: a distinct dark band of fully decomposed matter at the top of a forest soil
senses.definitionCN: 森林土壤顶部由充分腐解物质构成的明显深色层
senses.example: The humus layer under the beeches was thick and soft.
senses.exampleCN: 山毛榉林下的腐殖质层又厚又软。
senses.why: Where litter falls faster than it decays, the end product accumulates as its own layer within the profile.
senses.whyCN: 当枯落物落下的速度快于分解速度，最终产物便作为独立一层堆积在剖面中。

senses.title: Mature compost
senses.definition: the dark crumbly end product of a compost heap, ready to be dug into soil
senses.definitionCN: 堆肥堆腐熟后得到的深色疏松产物，可翻入土中
senses.example: The bin finally produced crumbly black humus after a year.
senses.exampleCN: 一年之后，堆肥箱终于产出了疏松的黑色腐殖质。
senses.why: Gardeners borrowed the soil-science word because mature compost is visually and chemically close to natural humus.
senses.whyCN: 园艺者借用了土壤学的这个词，因为成熟堆肥在外观与化学性质上都接近天然腐殖质。

senses.title: Humus from forest litter
senses.titleCN: 森林凋落物形成的腐殖质
senses.definition: the product of leaf litter, fungi and soil animals working together over decades
senses.definitionCN: 树叶、真菌与土壤动物经数十年共同作用形成的产物
senses.example: Fungi do most of the work that turns leaf litter into humus.
senses.exampleCN: 把落叶变成腐殖质的工作主要由真菌完成。
senses.why: Decay passes through fungal and animal stages, so humus is a residue of the whole food web rather than of one organism.
senses.whyCN: 腐解要经过真菌与动物几个阶段，因此腐殖质是整个食物网的残余，而不是某一种生物的产物。

senses.title: A measure of fertility
senses.definition: the percentage of humus used to compare soils and to judge how much organic input they need
senses.definitionCN: 用来比较土壤、判断需多少有机投入的腐殖质百分比
senses.example: The humus content fell sharply after decades of continuous cropping.
senses.exampleCN: 连续耕作几十年后，腐殖质含量大幅下降。
senses.why: Because humus stores nutrients and water, its share is a compact index of how well a soil will yield.
senses.whyCN: 由于腐殖质储存养分与水，它的比例就成了判断土壤产量表现的一个简洁指标。

senses.title: Humic substances in chemistry
senses.titleCN: 化学上的腐殖酸类物质
senses.definition: the extracted acids and fractions such as humic and fulvic acid studied in the laboratory
senses.definitionCN: 实验室提取研究的腐殖酸、富里酸等组分
senses.example: The study separated humic acids from the humus for analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 研究把腐殖酸从腐殖质中分离出来分析。
senses.why: Analysts needed soluble fractions rather than the whole dark material, so the word split into named chemical groups.
senses.whyCN: 分析者需要可溶组分而不是整块深色物质，因此这个词分裂成若干有名字的化学类别。

senses.title: Brown organic matter in water
senses.definition: dissolved dark organic matter that stains rivers and lakes brown
senses.definitionCN: 把河流与湖泊染成褐色的溶解态深色有机物
senses.example: Humus washed from the peat turned the stream tea-coloured.
senses.exampleCN: 从泥炭中洗出的腐殖质把溪水染成茶色。
senses.why: The same material that darkens soil dissolves in water, so hydrologists use the word for the colour it causes.
senses.whyCN: 在土中使它变黑的同一物质也能溶于水，因此水文学家用它来指所造成的颜色。

intro.en: Humus is simply the Latin noun for earth, ground or soil, taken into modern science unchanged. Latin humilis, low, and homo, human being, are related to it through the idea of ground.
intro.cn: humus 就是拉丁语表示土地、地面、土壤的名词，原样进入近代科学。拉丁 humilis「低」与 homo「人」都通过「土地」这一观念与之相关。

items.en: Humus meant earth, ground or soil, and it named the substance itself rather than any property of it.
items.cn: humus 意为土地、地面、土壤，命名的是物质本身，而不是它的某种性质。

items.en: Humilis, low or humble, comes from humus, on the ground; homo, a human being, was understood as earth-born. Both are genuine relatives, not look-alikes.
items.cn: humilis「低的、谦卑的」来自 humus「在地上」；homo「人」被理解为「土生的」。两者都是真正的同族词，而非仅仅形近。

items.en: Greek chamai, on the ground, is generally considered a cognate of this root, which suggests an old Indo-European word for ground.
items.cn: 希腊语 chamai「在地上」一般被认为是这个词根的同源词，这表明存在一个古老的印欧语「地面」词。

items.en: Nineteenth-century soil science adopted humus for the dark residue of decay, distinguishing it from fresh litter and from mineral matter.
items.cn: 十九世纪的土壤学采用 humus 指腐解的深色残余，把它与新鲜枯落物和矿物区分开。

items.en: Twentieth-century chemistry added humic and fulvic fractions, and limnology applied the word to brown dissolved matter in water.
items.cn: 二十世纪的化学补充了腐殖酸与富里酸组分，湖沼学又把这个词用于水中的褐色溶解物。

note.en: Group one holds words that share the Latin earth root and are often mistaken for unrelated look-alikes; group two holds organic materials often confused with humus.
note.cn: 第一组是共享拉丁「土地」词根、常被误认为只是形近的词；第二组是常与腐殖质混淆的有机材料。

entries.definition: From Latin homo, understood as earth-born; it shares the humus root rather than merely resembling it.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 homo，被理解为「土生的」；它与 humus 共享词根，而不只是形近。

entries.definition: From Latin humilis, low, literally on the ground, from humus; it describes position then character.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 humilis「低的」，字面为「在地上」，出自 humus；先指位置，后指品性。

entries.definition: ex- out plus humus earth: to bring a body out of the ground.
entries.definitionCN: ex-「出」加 humus「土」：把遗体从地下取出。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning relating to humus, used of acids and fractions rather than the whole material.
entries.definitionCN: 表示与腐殖质有关的形容词，多用于酸与组分，而非整块物质。

entries.definition: Organic waste decomposed under managed conditions; it becomes humus-like but is a product, not a soil fraction.
entries.definitionCN: 在人工管理条件下腐解的有机废弃物；它近似腐殖质，但属产品而非土壤组分。

entries.definition: Leaf litter rotted to a crumbly state; it is an input on its way to humus rather than the end product.
entries.definitionCN: 腐解到疏松状态的落叶；它是通往腐殖质的输入，而非最终产物。

entries.definition: Partly decayed plant matter preserved under water; it is not fully humified soil organic matter.
entries.definitionCN: 在水下保存的部分腐解植物残体；它并未完全腐殖化为土壤有机质。

entries.definition: All organic material in soil, fresh or decomposed; humus is only its stable dark end.
entries.definitionCN: 土壤中全部有机物质，无论新鲜或已腐解；腐殖质只是其稳定的深色末端。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin earth word and its genuine relatives, plus real soil-science terms.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁「土地」词及其真正同族词，加上真实的土壤学术语。

normal.en: Humus is the Latin word for earth, so humus is earth reduced to its richest form.
normal.cn: humus 是拉丁语的「土地」，因此腐殖质就是土地被浓缩成最肥沃的形态。

normal.en: Humble and human share the root: low to the ground, and earth-born.
normal.cn: humble 与 human 共享词根：贴近地面，以及土生。

normal.en: Humus is what is left when the leaf no longer looks like a leaf.
normal.cn: 当叶子不再像叶子时，剩下的就是腐殖质。

normal.en: The measurable index in soil tests is humus content.
normal.cn: 土壤检测中最可测的指标就是腐殖质含量。

normal.en: Humic acid is the extracted fraction, not the whole dark layer.
normal.cn: 腐殖酸是提取出的组分，而不是整层深色物质。

abstract.en: Picture a forest floor as a slow kitchen where leaves are cooked down to black crumbs.
abstract.cn: 想象林地地表是一间慢火厨房，把叶子熬成黑色碎屑。

abstract.en: Picture a sponge made of old leaves that holds rain for weeks.
abstract.cn: 想象一块由旧叶子做成的海绵，能把雨水含住几周。

abstract.en: Picture a river running tea-brown because the ground itself has dissolved into it.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河呈茶褐色，因为地面本身溶进了水里。

examples.en: Humus darkens the soil and keeps nutrients from washing away.
examples.cn: 腐殖质使土壤变深，并防止养分被冲走。

examples.en: The garden beds were improved with leaf humus every autumn.
examples.cn: 每年秋天都用落叶腐殖质改良花坛。

examples.en: Humus content is the first figure any soil test reports.
examples.cn: 腐殖质含量是任何土壤检测报告的第一个数字。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「胡姆斯」——林下那层黑乎乎、捏起来像海绵的土，就是腐殖质

root: 拉丁 humus「土地、地面、土壤」；同根另有 humilis「低的」（英语 humble）与 homo「人」（被理解为土生），希腊 chamai「在地上」一般视为同源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the soil fraction itself to its water-holding behaviour, its layer, compost, forest litter, fertility measurement, extracted acids, and finally the brown matter in water.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从土壤组分本身走到保水表现、独立层、堆肥、森林枯落物、肥力测定、提取的酸类，最后到水中的褐色物质。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a handful of black crumbly forest soil that holds water.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把黑褐色、能含水的林地土。

branches.en: ORIGIN: leaves and animals pass through fungi until only the stable residue remains.
branches.cn: 来源：叶子与动物经真菌作用，最后只剩下稳定残余。

branches.en: BEHAVIOUR: the crumb structure holds water and air at the same time.
branches.cn: 表现：团粒结构同时容纳水与空气。

branches.en: POSITION: where litter falls faster than it rots, humus forms its own band.
branches.cn: 位置：当枯落物落得快于腐解，腐殖质就自成一层。

branches.en: PRODUCT: a compost heap reaches the same look and feel.
branches.cn: 产品：堆肥堆最终也会达到同样的外观与手感。

branches.en: MEASUREMENT AND WATER: a fertility figure, extractable acids, and a brown stain in rivers.
branches.cn: 测定与水：一个肥力数值、可提取的酸，以及河流里的褐色。

intro.en: Humus is a bare Latin stem; the derived family uses -ic, -ification and compound forms such as humic acid.
intro.cn: humus 是一个光杆拉丁词干；派生族使用 -ic、-ification 以及 humic acid 这类复合形式。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Latin and has genuine Latin relatives, so the Latin entries below record both the noun and its adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 该词干来自拉丁语并有真正的拉丁同族词，因此下面的拉丁词条记录名词及其形容词。

items.example: Humus entered science without any change of spelling.
items.exampleCN: humus 进入科学时拼写毫无变化。

items.example: Humble reaches English through this Latin adjective.
items.exampleCN: humble 经这个拉丁形容词进入英语。

items.example: Human and humane both descend from homo.
items.exampleCN: human 与 humane 都源自 homo。

items.example: Humic substances colour the water brown.
items.exampleCN: 腐殖物质把水染成褐色。

items.example: Humification slows in cold, waterlogged soil.
items.exampleCN: 在寒冷积水的土壤里，腐殖化会变慢。

items.example: The humified layer sits above the mineral soil.
items.exampleCN: 腐殖化的那一层位于矿质土之上。

items.meaningCN: 腐殖质中可碱溶的组分
items.example: Humic acid was extracted with dilute alkali.
items.exampleCN: 腐殖酸用稀碱提取出来。

items.meaning: to bring out of the ground
items.example: The grave was exhumed for identification.
items.exampleCN: 为辨认身份而掘开了坟墓。

items.example: The custom was to inhume the dead outside the walls.
items.exampleCN: 当时的习俗是把死者葬在城墙之外。

latinEntries.example: Latin inhumare means to put into the earth.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 inhumare 意为「埋入土中」。

latinEntries.example: Latin humilis means low, literally on the ground.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 humilis 意为低的，字面义是「在地上的」。

definition_zh: adj. 内分泌的 / n. 内分泌腺；激素
definition_en: relating to glands that release their hormones straight into the blood rather than through a duct, or such a gland or hormone itself
core_image: 甲状腺像一面小旗贴在气管前方，把激素直接滴进旁边的血管，中间没有任何导管
scene: 诊室里，医生指着颈部说明腺体如何把激素直接送入血液。 The thyroid is a major endocrine gland.
sceneCN: 这里 endocrine 指「内分泌的」（第 1 个义项：腺体把分泌物直接送入血液）；句意是甲状腺是一处主要的内分泌腺。

pos.zh: 内分泌的；激素的
内分泌腺；激素

senses.title: Secreting inward
senses.definition: of a gland that releases its hormone directly into the blood
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）描述把激素直接释入血液的腺体
senses.example: The thyroid is a major endocrine gland.
senses.exampleCN: 甲状腺是一处主要的内分泌腺。
senses.why: A gland emptying straight into a passing vein instead of a duct
senses.whyCN: 腺体不走导管，而是直接把内容物倒进旁边流过的静脉

senses.title: The hormone system
senses.definition: relating to the whole set of hormone-secreting glands in the body
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）与体内整组激素腺体相关的
senses.example: Steroids act on the endocrine system and slow growth.
senses.exampleCN: 类固醇作用于内分泌系统并抑制发育。
senses.why: A chain of glands strung down the trunk like a line of lamps
senses.whyCN: 一串腺体像一排灯似的沿躯干垂下

senses.title: A gland as a thing
senses.definition: an endocrine gland, or the hormone it produces
senses.definitionCN: （名词）内分泌腺，或它所分泌的激素
senses.example: Surgeons removed two of the affected endocrines.
senses.exampleCN: 外科医生切除了两处病变的内分泌腺。
senses.why: A labelled jar of glands on the anatomy bench
senses.whyCN: 解剖台上一只贴着标签、装着腺体的玻璃罐

intro.en: Endocrine is Greek endon, within, plus krinein, to separate; an endocrine gland separates its product inward, into the tissue and blood, instead of sending it out through a duct.
intro.cn: endocrine 由希腊语 endon（在内）加 krinein（分开、筛选）构成；内分泌腺把产物向内分离、送进组织与血液，而不是经导管排到体外。

items.en: Endon is a Greek preposition meaning within or inside.
items.cn: endon 是希腊语介词，意为在内、在内部。

items.en: Krinein is Greek for to separate, and gives crisis and critic.
items.cn: krinein 在希腊语中意为分开、判断，给出 crisis 与 critic。

items.en: Endokrinos describes glands that separate inward and have no duct.
items.cn: endokrinos 形容向内分离、没有导管的腺体。

items.en: The adjective enters scientific English in the 19th century.
items.cn: 这一形容词在 19 世纪进入科技英语。

items.en: The ending -crine names modes of secretion, as in exocrine.
items.cn: 词尾 -crine 用来表示分泌方式，如 exocrine。

items.en: Endocrinology becomes the medical study of hormone glands.
items.cn: endocrinology 成为研究激素腺体的医学分支。

note.en: Endocrine uses the Greek combining form -crine, from krinein to separate; exocrine, autocrine and paracrine name other ways a gland releases its product, and endocrinology is the study of the whole system.
note.cn: endocrine 用了希腊构词成分 -crine（源自 krinein，分开）；exocrine、autocrine 与 paracrine 指明腺体排出产物的其他方式，endocrinology 则是对整套系统的研究。

normalIntro.cn: 把产物向内分离、送进血液的腺体

normal.en: En- is within, -crine is to separate: separated inward

normal.en: No duct and no exit: the hormone goes straight into blood

examples.cn: 甲状腺是一处主要的内分泌腺。

examples.en: Some pesticides act as endocrine disruptors in frogs.
examples.cn: 某些农药会干扰青蛙的内分泌。

examples.en: Doctors tested her blood for the affected endocrines.
examples.cn: 医生化验她的血液，检查病变的内分泌腺。

dict_mnemonic.text: endocrine ＝ endo-（在内，希腊 endon）＋ -crine（分开，希腊 krinein）＝「把产物向内分开」。腺体不经导管排出，而是直接送进血液，所以叫内分泌。名词 endocrinology 内分泌学，人物 endocrinologist 内分泌科医生。同一词尾还能造 exocrine 外分泌的、autocrine 自分泌的、paracrine 旁分泌的。常见搭配：the endocrine system 内分泌系统、an endocrine gland 内分泌腺、endocrine disorder 内分泌失调。记住 krinein 也给了 crisis 与 critic，都是「分开、判断」。

root: 希腊语 endon（在内）＋ krinein（分开、筛选）→ endocrine（内分泌的）

sensesIntro.en: Three uses: one gland, the whole hormone system, and the gland counted as a thing
sensesIntro.cn: 三个用法：单指一处腺体、指整套激素系统，以及把腺体当作一个个器官

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gland dripping its hormone straight into a passing vein
core.cn: 核心意象：一处腺体把激素直接滴进旁边流过的静脉

branches.en: A ductless gland empties into blood.
branches.cn: 无导管的腺体把分泌物排入血液。

branches.en: Many such glands form one system.
branches.cn: 许多这样的腺体组成一整套系统。

branches.en: Counted one by one, they are endocrines.
branches.cn: 一处一处地数，它们就是内分泌腺。

branches.en: Both keep the secret inside the body.
branches.cn: 两者都把分泌物留在身体内部。

branches.en: Both turn a single gland into a chain.
branches.cn: 两者都把一处腺体串进一条链。

intro.en: Endocrine is endo- plus -crine, from Greek krinein; the same ending builds exocrine and autocrine, while -logy turns it into a medical field.
intro.cn: endocrine 由 endo- 加 -crine（希腊语 krinein）构成；同一词尾构成 exocrine 与 autocrine，加 -logy 则成为一门医学分支。

latinIntro.en: Greek krinein means to separate or decide, and gives crisis, critic and criterion as well as the gland words ending in -crine.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 krinein 意为分开、判断，既给出 crisis、critic 与 criterion，也给出所有以 -crine 结尾的腺体用词。

definition_zh: 季节性的；季节限定的；随季节变化的
definition_en: happening, appearing or varying at a particular season of the year
core_image: 日历被折成四段，每段只挂一件在该段出现的东西：雨伞、麦穗、落叶、雪铲
scene: 河边的村子靠枣子收获季的短工过日子，其余月份几乎无事可做。 Riverside villages depend on seasonal work in the date harvest.
sceneCN: 这里 seasonal 指「只在一年某一季出现或进行的」（第 2 个义项：季节限定的工作）；句意为河边的村子靠枣子收获季的季节性短工维持生计。图中可辨识物件：枣椰树、采果篮、短工的手套、闲置的船。

pos.zh: 季节性的；季节限定的；随季节变化的

derivatives.zh: seasonal + -ly（副词后缀）→ 以随季节的方式
seasonal + -ity（拉丁 -itas 状态名词后缀）→ 随季节波动的性质
season + -able（形容词后缀）→ 合乎时令的（与 seasonal 侧重点不同）
season（调味义）+ -ing（动名词后缀）→ 调味品；此义与季节义另有来源
off-（离开）+ season → 淡季（的），seasonal 的反向时间带

senses.title: Varying with the time of year
senses.titleCN: 随一年中的时节而变化
senses.definition: changing in amount or level according to the time of year, as temperature or rainfall does
senses.definitionCN: 数量或水平随一年中的时节改变，如气温或降雨
senses.example: Seasonal variation in rainfall decides when the river rises.
senses.exampleCN: 降雨的季节性变化决定河水何时上涨。
senses.why: Season first meant the time for sowing, so anything seasonal is tied to a marked point in the farming year.
senses.whyCN: season 最初指播种的时节，因此 seasonal 之物都与农事年中某个被标记的时刻相连。

senses.title: Work that lasts only one season
senses.definition: describing a job, worker or contract that exists only for the busy weeks of a particular season
senses.definitionCN: 形容只存在于某一季繁忙数周内的工作、工人或合同
senses.example: Riverside villages depend on seasonal work in the date harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 河边的村子靠枣子收获季的季节性短工维持生计。
senses.why: Harvest arrives and leaves on a calendar, so the labour it needs is hired by the season rather than the year.
senses.whyCN: 收获按日历到来又离开，因此它所需的劳力按季节而非按年雇用。

senses.title: Produce available at its natural time
senses.titleCN: 在自然成熟时节上市的农产品
senses.definition: describing fruit, vegetables or game that is at its best and most plentiful in a particular part of the year
senses.definitionCN: 形容在一年某一时段最当令、最充足的果蔬或野味
senses.example: The market sells only seasonal produce, so the menu changes every month.
senses.exampleCN: 这个市场只卖应季农产品，所以菜单每月都变。
senses.why: Before cold storage and greenhouses, food itself kept the calendar, and the adjective marked that fact.
senses.whyCN: 在冷藏与温室普及之前，食物本身就带着日历，这个形容词标记了这一点。

senses.title: Open or usable only in part of the year
senses.titleCN: 一年中只在一定时段开放或可用的
senses.definition: describing a road, ferry, park or service that operates only during certain months
senses.definitionCN: 形容只在某些月份运营的道路、渡船、公园或服务
senses.example: A seasonal ferry links the two villages from May to September.
senses.exampleCN: 一条季节性渡船在五月到九月间连接两个村子。
senses.why: Ice, snow or demand closes the route for the rest of the year, so the service is seasonal by necessity.
senses.whyCN: 冰雪或需求让这条路线在一年其余时间关闭，因此服务在客观上只能是季节性的。

senses.title: Migrating or breeding at a fixed time
senses.titleCN: 在固定时节迁徙或繁殖
senses.definition: describing animal movement or reproduction that is triggered by the time of year
senses.definitionCN: 形容由一年中的时节触发的动物移动或繁殖
senses.example: Seasonal migration brings millions of birds through the delta.
senses.exampleCN: 季节性迁徙让数以百万计的鸟经过这片三角洲。
senses.why: Day length and food supply change on a schedule, and animals read that schedule as a signal.
senses.whyCN: 昼长与食物供应按时间表变化，动物把这张时间表当作信号来读。

senses.title: The clinical label for winter depression
senses.titleCN: 冬季抑郁的临床名称用法
senses.definition: naming a form of depression that returns at the same time each year, usually in winter
senses.definitionCN: 指每年同一时段复发、通常在冬季的抑郁类型
senses.example: Seasonal affective disorder responds to bright morning light.
senses.exampleCN: 季节性情感障碍对清晨强光有反应。
senses.why: The adjective in the diagnosis points to the calendar as the trigger, not to a lasting personality trait.
senses.whyCN: 诊断中的这个形容词把日历当作触发因素，而不是持久的人格特质。

senses.title: Adjusted for the calendar in statistics
senses.titleCN: 统计中剔除日历影响的用法
senses.definition: describing figures from which the normal yearly swing has been removed so that real trends can be seen
senses.definitionCN: 形容已剔除常规年度摆动、以便看出真实趋势的数据
senses.example: Seasonal adjustment showed that sales were actually falling.
senses.exampleCN: 季节调整显示销售额其实在下降。
senses.why: If every December is high, a December rise says nothing new, so statisticians subtract the seasonal pattern first.
senses.whyCN: 若每个十二月都高，十二月的上升说明不了新情况，因此统计人员先减去季节模式。

senses.title: Arranged according to the calendar
senses.definition: describing a schedule, budget or plan that is divided and timed by the seasons
senses.definitionCN: 形容按季节划分并安排时间的日程、预算或计划
senses.example: The farm keeps a seasonal calendar for sowing, spraying and harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 农场按播种、喷药与收获维护一份季节性日历。
senses.why: Here the adjective is about organisation rather than nature: the plan itself follows the four divisions of the year.
senses.whyCN: 这里的形容词讲的是组织方式而非自然现象：计划本身依照一年的四个分段。

intro.en: Seasonal is English season plus the Latin adjective suffix -al. Season itself comes through Old French from Latin satio 'a sowing', built on serere 'to sow'; its sense shifted from sowing time to a division of the year.
intro.cn: seasonal 是英语 season 加拉丁形容词后缀 -al。season 本身经古法语来自拉丁 satio「播种」，由 serere「播种」构成；词义从「播种时节」转为「一年的分段」。

items.en: Serere meant 'to sow, plant'. Its past participle satus supplies many Latin words about sowing and cultivation.
items.cn: serere 意为「播种、栽种」。其过去分词 satus 提供了许多与播种、耕作有关的拉丁词。

items.en: Satio meant 'a sowing, planting', later also the time of sowing. Old French turned it into seson, the source of English season.
items.cn: satio 意为「播种、栽种」，后来也指播种的时节。古法语把它变成 seson，即英语 season 的来源。

items.en: Old French seson already carried both 'sowing time' and 'proper time'; English widened it to the four divisions of the year.
items.cn: 古法语 seson 已同时带有「播种时节」与「合宜时机」两义；英语把它扩展为一年四季。

items.en: The noun settled into its calendar sense, while a separate culinary sense, 'to season food', came through Old French assaisonner.
items.cn: 这个名词固定为日历义；而「给食物调味」的烹饪义则经古法语 assaisonner 另成一线。

items.en: Seasonal is recorded in the nineteenth century. Sources differ on the exact year, so the date is approximate.
items.cn: seasonal 的书证见于十九世纪。各家记载的确切年份有出入，故为约数。

items.en: Twentieth-century statistics, medicine and tourism each gave the adjective a technical sense, from seasonal adjustment to seasonal affective disorder.
items.cn: 二十世纪的统计学、医学与旅游业各自赋予这个形容词技术义，从季节调整到季节性情感障碍。

note.en: Group one holds forms built on season that differ by suffix or sense; group two holds words for regular repetition in time.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 season、仅后缀或词义不同的形式；第二组是表示时间上有规律重复的词。

entries.definition: Built with -able: 'suitable to the season', as seasonable weather. It judges fitness, while seasonal merely marks the time.
entries.definitionCN: 由 -able 构成，意为「合于时令的」，如合时的天气。它评判合宜与否，seasonal 只标记时间。

entries.definition: The past participle of the verb season, meaning flavoured with salt or spices, or, of a person, made experienced by time.
entries.definitionCN: 动词 season 的过去分词，指加盐或香料调味，或指人经时间磨练而有经验。

entries.definition: The noun from the culinary verb, naming salt, herbs or spices; it has nothing to do with the calendar.
entries.definitionCN: 来自烹饪动词的名词，指盐、香草或香料；与日历无关。

entries.definition: The base noun can mean a division of the year or a period of activity, as the rainy season or the football season.
entries.definitionCN: 基础名词可指一年的分段，也可指某活动的时期，如雨季或足球赛季。

entries.definition: Repeating at regular intervals of any length, from seconds to decades; it does not require a yearly cycle.
entries.definitionCN: 以任意长度的固定间隔重复，从秒到十年皆可；不要求年度周期。

entries.definition: Happening once every year; a seasonal event may occur in one part of the year without being annual in this strict sense.
entries.definitionCN: 每年发生一次；季节性事件可发生在一年某一时段，却不一定严格地每年一次。

entries.definition: Moving through a repeating cycle, often economic; the cycle need not match the calendar year.
entries.definitionCN: 沿重复周期运动，常用于经济；周期不必与日历年一致。

entries.definition: Stopping and starting at uneven intervals, with no fixed calendar; seasonal implies a regular yearly rhythm.
entries.definitionCN: 以不均衡的间隔时断时续，没有固定日历；seasonal 则暗示规律的年度节律。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Season first meant sowing time; seasonal still carries that farming calendar inside it.
normal.cn: season 最初指播种时节；seasonal 至今仍把这张农事日历带在身上。

normal.en: The family runs season, seasonal, seasonally, seasonality, seasonable, seasoning.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 season、seasonal、seasonally、seasonality、seasonable、seasoning。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the range: seasonal work, seasonal variation, seasonal produce, seasonal adjustment.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出范围：季节性工作、季节变化、应季农产品、季节调整。

normal.en: Seasonal answers 'when in the year'; annual answers 'how often'; keep the two questions apart.
normal.cn: seasonal 回答「一年中的何时」，annual 回答「多久一次」；把两个问题分开。

normal.en: The suffix -al simply turns the noun season into an adjective, as nation gives national.
normal.cn: 后缀 -al 只是把名词 season 变成形容词，正如 nation 变成 national。

abstract.en: Picture a shop whose shelves change colour with the months.
abstract.cn: 想象一家货架颜色随月份改变的店。

abstract.en: Picture a river that only exists for part of the year and is a road for the rest.
abstract.cn: 想象一条一年只有部分时间存在的河，其余时间是路。

abstract.en: Picture a graph with one hill in the same place every year.
abstract.cn: 想象一张图，每年同一个位置都有一座山丘。

examples.en: Seasonal variation in rainfall decides when the river rises.
examples.cn: 降雨的季节性变化决定河水何时上涨。

examples.en: A seasonal ferry links the two villages from May to September.
examples.cn: 一条季节性渡船在五月到九月间连接两个村子。

examples.en: Seasonal adjustment showed that sales were actually falling.
examples.cn: 季节调整显示销售额其实在下降。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「四季呢」——一年四季都有它自己的安排 → 季节性的

root: season 经古法语 seson 来自拉丁 satio「播种」，由 serere「播种」构成；-al 为拉丁形容词后缀。英语 seasonal。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one gesture: the calendar divides the year and assigns each thing a slot. The gesture runs from weather to jobs, food, transport, animals, illness, statistics and finally to planning.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：日历把一年分开，并给每样东西指定一个位置。这个动作从天气到工作、食物、交通、动物、疾病、统计，最后到计划安排。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a calendar folded into four panels, each holding one object that belongs to it alone.
core.cn: 核心意象：折成四段的日历，每段只挂一件属于它的东西。

branches.en: CALENDAR SHAPE: nature varies by the year and people plan by the same divisions.
branches.cn: 日历形状：自然随年份变化，人也按同样的分段做计划。

branches.en: HARVEST WINDOW: work and food both appear in a narrow, dated window.
branches.cn: 收获窗口：工作与食物都在一个狭窄而有日期的窗口里出现。

branches.en: OPEN SEASON: a route or service exists only while conditions allow.
branches.cn: 开放季节：路线或服务只在条件允许时存在。

branches.en: ANIMAL SIGNAL: migration and breeding read the same calendar.
branches.cn: 动物信号：迁徙与繁殖读的是同一张日历。

branches.en: MEASURED RHYTHM: medicine names the illness and statistics remove the pattern.
branches.cn: 被测量的节律：医学为疾病命名，统计学把这一模式减掉。

intro.en: Seasonal is a native English noun with a Latin-derived adjective suffix; the noun's farming origin is still visible in its oldest sense.
intro.cn: seasonal 是英语本族名词加拉丁来源的形容词后缀；这个名词的农事出身在它最古老的义项里仍看得见。

latinIntro.en: Latin serere 'to sow' gives satio 'a sowing', which Old French reshaped into seson. The suffix -al comes from Latin -alis, as in national or natural.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 serere「播种」生出 satio「播种」，古法语把它改造成 seson。后缀 -al 来自拉丁 -alis，如 national、natural。

items.structure: serere, sevi, satum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
items.example: Fruges serunt.
items.exampleCN: 他们播种谷物。

items.example: Satio vere fit.
items.exampleCN: 播种在春天进行。

items.structure: Old French seson, from Latin satio
items.meaning: a division of the year; a period of activity
items.example: The rainy season begins in June.
items.exampleCN: 雨季在六月开始。

items.example: Seasonal rains refill the wells.
items.exampleCN: 季节性降雨重新灌满水井。

items.example: The lake level varies seasonally.
items.exampleCN: 湖面随季节变化。

items.meaning: the quality of varying with seasons
items.example: Seasonality is strong in the tourist trade.
items.exampleCN: 旅游业的季节性很强。

items.example: Seasonable weather helped the harvest.
items.exampleCN: 合时的天气帮了收获。

items.example: The soup needs more seasoning.
items.exampleCN: 这汤需要多加调味。

items.meaning: the quiet part of the year
items.example: Hotels cut prices in the off-season.
items.exampleCN: 旅馆在淡季降价。

definition_zh: 巴西利卡；古罗马长方形会堂；早期基督教长方形教堂；天主教宗座圣殿
definition_en: a long rectangular hall used in ancient Rome for public business, later the standard plan of early Christian churches, or a church holding a papal honour
core_image: 一条长长的中殿通向半圆后殿，两侧各有一道侧廊，人流从中间穿过
scene: 石阶通向一座长厅，中央宽道一直通到半圆形的后殿。 The basilica in the forum once held law courts and market stalls under one roof.
sceneCN: 这里 basilica 指「古罗马用于公共事务的长方形会堂」（第 1 个义项：古罗马公共会堂）；句意为广场上那座巴西利卡曾在同一屋顶下容纳法庭与市集摊位。图中可辨识物件：长厅、中央宽道、半圆后殿、石阶。

pos.zh: 巴西利卡；长方形会堂式教堂
宗座圣殿（天主教荣衔）

senses.title: A Roman public hall
senses.definition: a long roofed hall in a Roman forum used for courts, markets and public business
senses.definitionCN: 罗马广场上用于法庭、市集与公共事务的长形有顶大厅
senses.example: The basilica in the forum doubled as a courtroom and a trading floor.
senses.exampleCN: 广场上的巴西利卡同时充当法庭与交易场。
senses.why: the word first named a civic building, not a church: it was the roofed public space where a city did its business.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指市政建筑而非教堂：它是城市办理公共事务的有顶空间。

senses.title: The early Christian church plan
senses.definition: a church built on the Roman hall plan, with a wide nave, side aisles and a semicircular apse
senses.definitionCN: 沿用罗马会堂平面的教堂，有宽中殿、侧廊与半圆后殿
senses.example: The first basilica on the site had a wooden roof and no dome.
senses.exampleCN: 此地最早的巴西利卡式教堂是木顶，没有穹顶。
senses.why: early Christians adopted the hall because it held a crowd and let the whole assembly face one end.
senses.whyCN: 早期基督徒采用这种会堂，因为它能容纳人群，并让全体会众朝向同一端。

senses.title: A papal honour
senses.definition: a church granted special status by the pope, ranked as major or minor
senses.definitionCN: 由教宗授予特殊地位的教堂，分特级与次级
senses.example: The parish was raised to the rank of minor basilica last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这座堂区教堂去年被升格为次级宗座圣殿。
senses.why: the title no longer describes the shape, only the privilege, so an ordinary-looking church can be a basilica.
senses.whyCN: 这个称号不再描述形状，只表示特权，因此外观普通的教堂也可以是宗座圣殿。

senses.title: A Byzantine hall church
senses.definition: the long hall church form used in Byzantine lands, often vaulted and colonnaded
senses.definitionCN: 拜占庭地区常用的长厅式教堂，常带拱顶与列柱
senses.example: The basilica in the old quarter is roofed with brick vaults.
senses.exampleCN: 老城区那座巴西利卡式教堂以砖拱为顶。
senses.why: the eastern church kept the hall plan but replaced timber with masonry, giving the type a second architectural life.
senses.whyCN: 东方教会保留长厅平面却以砖石代替木料，使这一类型获得第二次建筑生命。

senses.title: The hall plan itself
senses.definition: the layout of a central wide nave flanked by narrower aisles and closed by an apse
senses.definitionCN: 中央宽中殿、两侧较窄侧廊、末端以半圆后殿收束的布局
senses.example: The architect kept the basilica plan but opened the roof to the sky.
senses.exampleCN: 建筑师保留了巴西利卡式平面，却把屋顶向天空敞开。
senses.why: once the plan became a pattern, the word could name a layout independent of any building's use.
senses.whyCN: 一旦平面成为范式，这个词就能指一种独立于用途的布局。

senses.title: A privileged place of pilgrimage
senses.definition: a church with indulgences and privileges that make it a pilgrimage destination
senses.definitionCN: 带有赦罪与特权、因而成为朝圣目的地的教堂
senses.example: Pilgrims queue at the basilica door on the feast day.
senses.exampleCN: 节日当天朝圣者在圣殿门口排队。
senses.why: honorary rank brings concrete privileges, and privileges bring crowds, so rank and pilgrimage belong together.
senses.whyCN: 荣衔带来实际特权，特权带来人群，因此等级与朝圣总是相连。

senses.title: A modern hall in the old shape
senses.titleCN: 现代仿巴西利卡式大厅
senses.definition: a modern civic or exhibition hall built with a long nave and aisles for ceremonial effect
senses.definitionCN: 为营造仪式感而建成长中殿加侧廊的现代市政或展览大厅
senses.example: The railway station borrows the basilica form for its main concourse.
senses.exampleCN: 火车站的主大厅借用了巴西利卡的形式。
senses.why: the plan still reads as dignified and communal, so modern builders reuse it without any religious purpose.
senses.whyCN: 这种平面至今仍显得庄重而有公共感，因此现代建造者在毫无宗教用途时也复用。

senses.title: A category in archaeology
senses.definition: a type label used to sort Roman civic halls and early church buildings in excavation reports
senses.definitionCN: 发掘报告中用来为罗马市政会堂与早期教堂分类的类型标签
senses.example: The excavation report lists three basilicas under the modern square.
senses.exampleCN: 发掘报告列出今日广场之下的三座巴西利卡。
senses.why: classification is where a building word becomes a tool for reading a site's history.
senses.whyCN: 正是在分类之中，一个建筑词变成解读遗址历史的工具。

intro.en: Basilica is a Greek adjective used as a noun in Latin, meaning 'royal hall', and it moved from civic architecture to church architecture. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: basilica 本是一个希腊语形容词，在拉丁语中作名词使用，意为「王者之厅」，并从市政建筑移入教堂建筑。年代均为约数。

items.en: Basileus meant king or sovereign, and its adjective basilikos meant royal or kingly.
items.cn: basileus 指国王或君主，其形容词 basilikos 意为王的、王者般的。

items.en: The phrase for the royal portico, a covered colonnade in the Athenian agora, was shortened into a single noun.
items.cn: 指「王者柱廊」的短语，即雅典集市中的有顶柱廊，后来缩略为一个名词。

items.en: Latin took the word for a large public hall, used for courts and commerce, without any sacred meaning.
items.cn: 拉丁语用这个词指大型公共会堂，供法庭与商业使用，并无神圣含义。

items.en: From the fourth century Christians built their main churches on the hall plan and kept the old name.
items.cn: 从四世纪起，基督徒按会堂平面建造主要教堂，并沿用了旧名。

items.en: In later canon law the word became an honorary rank conferred by the pope on selected churches.
items.cn: 在后来的教会法中，这个词成为教宗授予特定教堂的荣誉等级。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Greek ancestry of basileus is not established, and the usual suggestion of a loan from an older Aegean language remains a hypothesis.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深来源）：basileus 在希腊语之前的谱系未得到证明，通常认为它借自更早的爱琴海语言，那仍只是假说。

note.en: Group one holds building words built on the same royal root or easily confused with the rank; group two holds church types defined another way.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「王者」词根或容易与这一等级混淆的建筑词；第二组是以其他方式定义的教堂类型。

entries.definition: The Greek word for king that stands behind basilica, but it never names a building.
entries.definitionCN: 巴西利卡背后的希腊语「国王」一词，但它从不指建筑。

entries.definition: Describing the long hall form; the adjective says nothing about papal rank.
entries.definitionCN: 描述长厅形制的形容词，与教宗授予的等级无关。

entries.definition: The bishop's church; a basilica is defined by a papal honour, so a building may be one, the other, or both.
entries.definitionCN: 主教座堂以主教座位定义，而巴西利卡以教宗荣衔定义，同一建筑可以居其一或兼有。

entries.definition: The herb is from Greek basileus too, but through a different word for a royal plant; it has no link to buildings.
entries.definitionCN: 这种香草也源于希腊语「王」，但走的是「王者之草」另一条词线，与建筑无关。

entries.definition: The long central space of a church; it is one part of a basilica, not the whole building.
entries.definitionCN: 教堂中央的长空间，是巴西利卡的一部分，而非整座建筑。

entries.definition: A narrow passage beside the nave; basilicas are defined by having them, but an aisle is not a building.
entries.definitionCN: 中殿旁的窄通道；巴西利卡以拥有侧廊为特征，但侧廊本身不是建筑。

entries.definition: A church whose nave and aisles are of equal height; it contrasts with the taller nave of a basilica.
entries.definitionCN: 中殿与侧廊等高的教堂，与中殿更高的巴西利卡形成对照。

entries.definition: The most sacred part of a church; the word concerns holiness, not plan or rank.
entries.definitionCN: 教堂中最神圣的部分；这个词关乎神圣性，而非平面或等级。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real royal root, the real plan words and the real papal rank.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「王者」词根、真实的平面术语与真实的教宗等级。

normal.en: The word began as 'royal hall' and only later meant a church.
normal.cn: 这个词最初是「王者之厅」，后来才指教堂。

normal.en: The family runs basilica, basilican, basilical, basilica plan, archbasilica.
normal.cn: 同族说法包括 basilica、basilican、basilical、basilica plan、archbasilica。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the rank: major basilica, minor basilica, papal basilica.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出等级：特级宗座圣殿、次级宗座圣殿、教宗圣殿。

normal.en: The plan has three parts: a wide nave, narrow aisles, and a rounded apse at the end.
normal.cn: 这种平面分三段：宽中殿、窄侧廊、末端的半圆后殿。

normal.en: A basilica may also be a cathedral, but neither word implies the other.
normal.cn: 巴西利卡也可能同时是主教座堂，但两个词互不蕴含。

abstract.en: Picture a king's covered walkway emptied of the king and filled with merchants.
abstract.cn: 想象一条属于国王的有顶长廊，国王走了，商人挤了进来。

abstract.en: Picture a single long room that can be a court in the morning and a church at night.
abstract.cn: 想象一间长屋，上午是法庭，晚上是教堂。

abstract.en: Picture a modern hall that keeps the old aisle rhythm but sells tickets at the door.
abstract.cn: 想象一座现代大厅保留旧时的侧廊节奏，却在门口卖票。

examples.en: The Roman basilica had no religious function at all.
examples.cn: 古罗马的巴西利卡完全没有宗教功能。

examples.en: The basilica's apse still holds its original mosaic.
examples.cn: 这座巴西利卡的后殿仍保有原来的镶嵌画。

examples.en: The pope raised the shrine to the rank of minor basilica.
examples.cn: 教宗把这处圣地升格为次级宗座圣殿。

dict_mnemonic.text: basileus（王）+ ica（……的）→ 王者之厅 → 罗马会堂 → 长方形教堂、宗座圣殿

root: 希腊 basilikē「王者柱廊」来自 basileus「王」+ basilikos「王的」；拉丁 basilica 指公共会堂，后为教堂形制与教宗荣衔。英语 basilica。basileus 更深来源不确定，一般认为是借词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one long room: a royal hall becomes a civic hall, then a church plan, then a rank, then a layout, a pilgrimage site, a modern hall and a dig-site label.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一间长屋展开：王者之厅成为公共会堂，再成为教堂形制、荣誉等级、平面布局、朝圣地、现代大厅，最后成为遗址标签。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one long roofed lane with side lanes, ending in a rounded niche.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条有顶的长廊，两侧各有窄道，末端收进一个半圆凹室。

branches.en: THE HALL: the first sense is the Roman civic building where courts and trade shared a roof.
branches.cn: 会堂：第一个义项是法庭与交易共用一顶屋顶的罗马市政建筑。

branches.en: THE CHURCH PLAN: western timber roofs and eastern masonry vaults both kept the long hall.
branches.cn: 教堂平面：西方木顶与东方砖拱都保留了这间长厅。

branches.en: THE HONOUR: papal rank replaces shape, and privilege turns the church into a destination.
branches.cn: 荣衔：教宗授予的等级取代了形状，特权又把教堂变成目的地。

branches.en: THE PATTERN: the layout outlives its uses and returns in secular halls.
branches.cn: 范式：布局比用途活得更久，并在世俗大厅中回归。

branches.en: THE LABEL: archaeology turns the building word into a sorting tool.
branches.cn: 标签：考古学把这个建筑词变成分类工具。

intro.en: Basilica is a Greek royal adjective that Latin turned into a building noun, so its parts explain both the throne and the hall.
intro.cn: basilica 是一个希腊语「王者」形容词，被拉丁语转为建筑名词，其构件同时解释了王座与厅堂。

latinIntro.en: Greek basileus and basilikos passed into Latin as the building name basilica; the church adjective basilicanus followed.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 basileus 与 basilikos 经拉丁语形成建筑名 basilica，随后又有教会形容词 basilicanus。

items.example: The root names a king, not a building.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指的是国王，而非建筑。

items.example: The adjective turned a hall into a royal hall.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词把一间厅堂变成王者之厅。

items.example: The portico gave the building type its name.
items.exampleCN: 这条柱廊给了这种建筑类型名称。

items.example: A Roman basilica held courts and shops.
items.exampleCN: 罗马的巴西利卡容纳法庭与商铺。

items.example: The basilican nave runs the full length.
items.exampleCN: 巴西利卡式中殿贯通全长。

items.example: The basilical plan was copied in brick.
items.exampleCN: 巴西利卡式平面被用砖复制。

items.example: The drawing labels the basilica plan.
items.exampleCN: 图纸标出了巴西利卡式平面。

items.meaning: a lower rank of papal church
items.example: The shrine became a minor basilica.
items.exampleCN: 这处圣地成为次级宗座圣殿。

definition_zh: 大气环流；大气中热量与水汽的大尺度输送与循环
definition_en: the large-scale movement of air that carries heat and moisture around a planet
core_image: 一张挂在墙上的全球地图，上面画满从赤道升起、向两极弯曲的箭头
scene: 气象台的屏幕上，一圈圈箭头从赤道升起、向两极偏转，值班员在图上标出雨带。 The map showed atmospheric circulation lifting warm air at the equator and turning it poleward.
sceneCN: 这里指全球尺度的大气环流（第 1 个义项：大气热量与水汽的大范围输送）；句意为图上显示大气环流在赤道抬起暖空气，并使其向极地方向偏转。图中可辨识物件：气象屏、箭头流线、雨带标记、全球地图。

pos.zh: 名词短语：多作不可数，指大气的大尺度环流；强调某一具体环流时可加修饰语

derivatives.zh: 由希腊语表示「蒸汽」与「球体」的成分构成，义为「大气；气氛」
由本短语第一成分构成，义为「大气的」
由拉丁语表示「小环」的名词构成的动词，义为「循环；流通」
由动词加表示「作用、过程」的词尾构成，义为「循环；流通」
由本短语第二成分加形容词词尾构成，义为「循环的」

senses.title: Global circulation
senses.definition: the planet-wide system of winds that moves heat from warm regions to cold ones
senses.definitionCN: 把热量从温暖区域输送到寒冷区域的行星尺度风系
senses.example: Atmospheric circulation carries heat from the tropics toward the poles.
senses.exampleCN: 大气环流把热量从热带输送到两极。
senses.why: Without a moving atmosphere the tropics would keep their heat and the poles would keep their cold.
senses.whyCN: 若没有运动的大气，热带会一直保有热量，两极则一直寒冷。

senses.title: The three-cell model
senses.definition: the textbook division of global circulation into polar, mid-latitude and tropical cells
senses.definitionCN: 教科书把全球环流分为极地、中纬度与热带三个环流圈
senses.example: The three-cell model simplifies atmospheric circulation into polar, mid-latitude and tropical cells.
senses.exampleCN: 三圈环流模型把大气环流简化为极地、中纬度与热带三个环流圈。
senses.why: A single cell cannot span a rotating planet, so the flow breaks into three bands per hemisphere.
senses.whyCN: 单个环流圈无法覆盖一颗自转的行星，因此每个半球分裂为三段。

senses.title: The Hadley cell
senses.definition: the tropical overturning in which air rises at the equator, flows poleward aloft and sinks near thirty degrees
senses.definitionCN: 热带地区的翻转环流：空气在赤道上升，高空向极地流动，在纬度约三十度处下沉
senses.example: The Hadley cell is the tropical part of atmospheric circulation.
senses.exampleCN: 哈得来环流是大气环流中热带的那一部分。
senses.why: A named cell makes the tropics a single machine with a rising and a sinking side.
senses.whyCN: 一个被命名的环流圈把热带变成一台只有上升侧与下沉侧的机器。

senses.title: The Walker circulation
senses.definition: the east-west overturning over the equatorial Pacific that links sea temperature to rainfall
senses.definitionCN: 赤道太平洋上东西方向的翻转环流，把海温与降水联系起来
senses.example: The Walker circulation is a key part of atmospheric circulation over the Pacific.
senses.exampleCN: 沃克环流是太平洋上空大气环流的关键部分。
senses.why: The tropics also overturn along the equator, not only across latitudes.
senses.whyCN: 热带不仅在纬向翻转，也沿赤道方向翻转。

senses.title: The jet stream
senses.definition: a narrow fast current of air in the upper troposphere that steers weather systems
senses.definitionCN: 对流层上部狭窄而快速的气流，引导天气系统移动
senses.example: Jet streams are fast ribbons within the upper atmospheric circulation.
senses.exampleCN: 急流是上层大气环流中快速的气带。
senses.why: Concentrating the flow into a narrow band makes it far faster than the surrounding air.
senses.whyCN: 把流动集中于狭窄的一条，使它远快于周围空气。

senses.title: Monsoon circulation
senses.definition: a seasonal reversal of winds between land and sea caused by uneven heating
senses.definitionCN: 海陆受热不均导致风向随季节反向的环流
senses.example: Monsoon circulation is the seasonal part of atmospheric circulation that reverses with the seasons.
senses.exampleCN: 季风环流是大气环流中随季节反向的那一部分。
senses.why: Land heats faster than water, so the pressure pattern flips and the wind follows.
senses.whyCN: 陆地升温快于水面，气压格局翻转，风便随之转向。

senses.title: Circulation and climate zones
senses.definition: the link between patterns of rising and sinking air and the wet or dry zones they produce
senses.definitionCN: 空气上升与下沉的格局同其所造成的湿润或干旱地带之间的联系
senses.example: Regions with weak atmospheric circulation receive little rainfall.
senses.exampleCN: 大气环流较弱的地区降水很少。
senses.why: Rising air rains and sinking air dries, so the map of circulation becomes a map of climates.
senses.whyCN: 上升的空气下雨，下沉的空气致旱，环流图因此成了气候图。

senses.title: Circulation on other planets
senses.definition: the wind systems of other atmospheres, shaped by their own rotation, heating and composition
senses.definitionCN: 其他天体大气的风系，由其自转、受热与成分塑形
senses.example: Venus has an atmospheric circulation that turns far faster than the planet itself.
senses.exampleCN: 金星的大气环流旋转得远比行星本身快。
senses.why: The same physics applied elsewhere produces circulation patterns that no earthly textbook predicts.
senses.whyCN: 同一套物理用到别处，会产生地球教科书无法预言的运动格局。

senses.title: Indoor air circulation
senses.definition: the movement of air within a room that keeps temperature and freshness even
senses.definitionCN: 房间内使温度与新鲜度保持均匀的空气流动
senses.example: Good atmospheric circulation in a room keeps the air from going stale.
senses.exampleCN: 房间内良好的空气循环能防止空气变得沉闷。
senses.why: The same words scale down from a planet to a room, because both depend on air being moved rather than still.
senses.whyCN: 同一组词从行星缩小到房间仍可用，因为两者都依赖空气被移动而非静止。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Greek-derived adjective for the vapour sphere around a world to a Latin-derived noun for movement in a ring. Both elements are well documented; the phrase took its meteorological sense in the nineteenth century, so its first use is approximate.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一个源自希腊语、表示环绕世界的蒸汽层的形容词，与一个源自拉丁语、表示环状运动的名词组合起来。两个成分来源有据；短语在十九世纪取得气象学含义，确切首见为约数。

items.en: Atmos meant vapour or steam, the invisible envelope of a world.
items.cn: 这个词表示蒸汽或雾气，即环绕世界的那层看不见的东西。

items.en: Sphaira meant a ball or sphere, and the two together named the vapour sphere.
items.cn: 这个词表示球体，两者合起来命名了「蒸汽之球」。

items.en: Circulus was a small ring, the diminutive of the word for a circle.
items.cn: 这个词是表示圆的名词的小称，意为小环。

items.en: The verb meant to make round or to move in a circle.
items.cn: 这个动词意为做成圆形或在环中运动。

items.en: English first applied the noun to blood, then to any fluid moving in a circuit.
items.cn: 英语先用这个名词指血液循环，后指任何沿回路流动的流体。

items.en: Nineteenth-century meteorology needed a term for planetary-scale wind systems, and the two words were joined.
items.cn: 十九世纪的气象学需要一个指行星尺度风系的术语，两个词于是被组合起来。

note.en: The first group shares the adjective atmospheric or the noun circulation; the second group names the motion of air in plainer terms.
note.cn: 第一组共享形容词「大气的」或名词「环流」；第二组用更朴素的说法指空气的运动。

entries.definition: The weight of the air column at a point.
entries.definitionCN: 某点上空气柱的重量。

entries.definition: One of the stacked shells of a planet's air.
entries.definitionCN: 行星大气层叠结构中的一层。

entries.definition: A numerical representation of the state of the air.
entries.definitionCN: 对大气状态的数值表示。

entries.definition: Movement of a fluid around a closed path.
entries.definitionCN: 流体沿闭合路径的运动。

entries.definition: The envelope of gas around a planet.
entries.definitionCN: 行星周围的气体外壳。

entries.definition: The movement of air from one place to another.
entries.definitionCN: 空气从一处到另一处的运动。

entries.definition: The recurring shape of winds over a region.
entries.definitionCN: 某一地区风的反复出现的形态。

entries.definition: Vertical motion driven by heating from below.
entries.definitionCN: 由下方加热驱动的垂直运动。

entries.definition: The whole set of prevailing winds on a planet.
entries.definitionCN: 一颗行星上全部盛行风的总和。

entries.definition: A moving pattern of pressure, cloud and rain.
entries.definitionCN: 移动的气压、云与降水格局。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations start at the equator and follow the arrows outward and back; abstract ones treat circulation as a way of evening out what the sun makes uneven.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想从赤道出发，沿着箭头向外再返回；抽象联想把环流看作把太阳造成的不均匀重新摊平的方式。

normal.en: Warm air rises at the equator and turns poleward.
normal.cn: 暖空气在赤道上升，并向极地方向偏转。

normal.en: It sinks near thirty degrees, which is why deserts sit there.
normal.cn: 它在纬度约三十度处下沉，沙漠因此分布在那里。

normal.en: Each hemisphere splits into three cells because the planet spins.
normal.cn: 由于行星自转，每个半球分成三个环流圈。

normal.en: A jet stream is the fast core of the upper flow.
normal.cn: 急流是上层气流中速度快的那条核心。

normal.en: Over the Pacific the flow also turns east to west, and that is the Walker cell.
normal.cn: 在太平洋上空气流还东西向翻转，那就是沃克环流。

abstract.en: Circulation is the atmosphere refusing to let heat stay where it landed.
abstract.cn: 环流是大气拒绝让热量留在原地。

abstract.en: Every rising column must have somewhere to sink.
abstract.cn: 每一处上升的气柱都必须在某处下沉。

abstract.en: Wind is not weather's decoration; it is its accounting system.
abstract.cn: 风不是天气的装饰，而是天气的记账系统。

examples.en: Atmospheric circulation redistributes heat from low to high latitudes.
examples.cn: 大气环流把热量从低纬重新分配到高纬。

examples.en: The study linked weaker atmospheric circulation to drier summers.
examples.cn: 这项研究把减弱的大气环流与更干旱的夏季联系起来。

examples.en: Climate models resolve atmospheric circulation at ever finer scales.
examples.cn: 气候模式以越来越精细的尺度解析大气环流。

dict_mnemonic.text: atmospheric（大气的）+ circulation（循环）——大气的循环，即大气环流

root: 由 atmospheric 与 circulation 组合。前者源自希腊语 atmos「蒸汽」与 sphaira「球体」；后者源自拉丁语 circulus「小环」及其动词 circulare「使成环状」。短语在十九世纪气象学中取得现代含义，确切首见年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses move outward from the planet-wide flow to its cells, its jet, its seasonal reversal, its climates, other worlds and finally a single room.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从行星尺度的流动向外展开，走向各个环流圈、急流、季节反转、气候带、其他天体，最后收束到一个房间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: arrows rising at the equator and bending toward the poles on a wall map.
core.cn: 核心意象：墙图上从赤道升起、向两极弯曲的箭头。

branches.en: THE CORE: the whole moving envelope and the three-cell shorthand used to teach it.
branches.cn: 核心：整个运动的大气层，以及用于教学的「三圈」简写。

branches.en: THE NAMED CELLS: one overturning across latitudes, one across the equatorial Pacific.
branches.cn: 被命名的环流圈：一个跨纬度翻转，一个沿赤道太平洋翻转。

branches.en: THE FAST AND SEASONAL: a narrow upper jet and a wind that reverses with the seasons.
branches.cn: 快速与季节性的两种：狭窄的高空急流，以及随季节反向的风。

branches.en: THE SCALES: wet and dry climate zones, other planets, and a single room.
branches.cn: 尺度变化：干湿气候带、其他行星，以及单个房间。

branches.en: THE COMPARISON: circulation on a world that spins differently.
branches.cn: 比较对象：自转方式不同的世界上的环流。

intro.en: A Greek noun of vapour plus a Greek noun of sphere give the first element; a Latin ring gives the second.
intro.cn: 一个希腊语「蒸汽」名词加一个希腊语「球体」名词构成第一成分；一个拉丁语「环」构成第二成分。

latinIntro.en: Greek supplies atmos and sphaira; Latin supplies circulus, its verb and the noun of motion.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语提供了「蒸汽」与「球体」；拉丁语提供了「小环」、其动词以及表示运动的名词。

items.example: It named the invisible envelope rather than the air itself.
items.exampleCN: 它命名的是看不见的外壳，而非空气本身。

items.example: It supplied the second half of atmosphere.
items.exampleCN: 它提供了「大气」一词的后半部分。

items.example: It turns atmosphere into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把「大气」变成形容词。

items.example: The diminutive sense survives in the idea of a closed loop.
items.exampleCN: 小称含义残留在「闭合回路」这一观念中。

items.meaning: to make round, to move in a circle
items.example: The verb yields the English verb circulate.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词产生英语动词「循环」。

items.example: It names movement around a circuit.
items.exampleCN: 它命名沿回路的运动。

items.example: The noun first described blood and later air.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词先指血液，后指空气。

items.example: The adjective makes the phrase specific to a planet's air.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词使短语专门指行星的大气。

definition_zh: 特征；特质；性状；一点、一丝（某性质）；一笔（旧义）
definition_en: a distinguishing quality of a person, group or living thing, or a slight amount of something
core_image: 一张脸上只用一笔勾出的那道线，远看是轮廓，近看才知道是标记
scene: 同窝的幼犬里，只有一只从头到尾都不往人跟前凑，训导员在记录表上给它画了一道。 That single trait decided which puppy went to the quiet household.
sceneCN: 这里 trait 指「一个可辨认、相对稳定的特征」（第 1 个义项：性格或性状上的特征）；句意是这一个特征决定了哪只幼犬被送去安静的人家。图中可辨识物件：记录表上的一道笔划、蜷在角落的幼犬、伸手的训导员。

pos.zh: 特征；特质；性状
一点；一丝；一笔

senses.title: A distinguishing quality
senses.titleCN: 一个可辨认的区别性品质
senses.definition: a stable quality that marks a person out from others
senses.definitionCN: 使人区别于他人的一项稳定品质
senses.example: That single trait decided which puppy went to the quiet household.
senses.exampleCN: 这一个特征决定了哪只幼犬被送去安静的人家。
senses.why: the word began as a drawn line, and a line is exactly what marks one thing off from another.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指画出的一条线，而线正是把一物与另一物分开的标记。

senses.title: A feature of a thing
senses.definition: a noticeable property of an object, system or style
senses.definitionCN: 物体、制度或风格上明显可见的一项属性
senses.example: The script's most useful trait is that it can be read upside down.
senses.exampleCN: 这种文字最有用的一点是倒着也能读。
senses.why: the line can be drawn on anything, so the word easily leaves people and attaches to objects.
senses.whyCN: 线可以画在任何东西上，因此这个词很容易离开人，附到物上。

senses.title: A slight amount
senses.definition: a small trace of a quality, in older or literary usage
senses.definitionCN: 某种性质的一点点痕迹，属较旧或文学化的用法
senses.example: There was a trait of irony in the old man's courtesy.
senses.exampleCN: 老人的礼貌里带一丝讥讽。
senses.why: a single drawn stroke is also the smallest visible amount, which is how the word came to mean a trace.
senses.whyCN: 单独画出的一笔也是最小的可见量，这个词由此有了「一丝」的意思。

senses.title: A biological character
senses.definition: an inherited characteristic of an organism, such as eye colour
senses.definitionCN: 生物体遗传而来的特征，如眼睛颜色
senses.example: Sickle cell is a trait that protects against one kind of malaria.
senses.exampleCN: 镰状细胞是一种能抵抗某类疟疾的性状。
senses.why: genetics needed a countable unit and borrowed the same word, keeping the idea of a marked feature.
senses.whyCN: 遗传学需要一个可计数的单位，借用了同一个词，保留了「被标出的特征」这一观念。

senses.title: A recurring way of acting
senses.definition: a habit of behaviour treated as evidence of something deeper
senses.definitionCN: 被当作更深层之证据的行为习惯
senses.example: Interrupting is a trait his colleagues have learned to expect.
senses.exampleCN: 打断别人是他同事已学会预期的一个特点。
senses.why: one act is an event, but repetition turns it into a trait, which is why observers wait before naming one.
senses.whyCN: 一次行为是一个事件，重复才把它变成特质，因此观察者会等一等再命名。

senses.title: Something a group shares
senses.definition: a feature common to a culture, generation or kind
senses.definitionCN: 文化、世代或类别中共同具有的特征
senses.example: Suspicion of strangers is a trait of the region rather than of the family.
senses.exampleCN: 对外人的戒心是这个地区的特征，而不是这一家的。
senses.why: the same mark can be drawn around many people at once, which lets the word describe a collective.
senses.whyCN: 同一个标记可以一次画在一群人周围，这就让这个词能描述集体。

senses.title: A stroke of the pen
senses.definition: the original sense: a single line drawn by hand
senses.definitionCN: 本义：手画出的一条线
senses.example: The mapmaker added one trait and the border changed.
senses.exampleCN: 绘图者添了一笔，边界就变了。
senses.why: this is the literal sense from which all the others radiate, and it survives in careful historical writing.
senses.whyCN: 这是所有其他义项由之辐射的字面义，在严谨的历史写作中仍然存留。

senses.title: A line of the face
senses.definition: in literary description, a feature of the face or outline
senses.definitionCN: 在文学描写中指面部或轮廓上的一道线
senses.example: The portrait catches one trait of the mouth and nothing else.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅肖像只抓住了嘴部的一道线，别的都没有。
senses.why: a face is read line by line, so the oldest drawing sense survives most naturally in portraits.
senses.whyCN: 脸是一道道线读出来的，因此最古老的「划线」义在肖像描写里保存得最自然。

intro.en: Trait comes from French trait, from Latin tractus 'a drawing, a line, a pull', from trahere 'to draw, drag'. English borrowed it in the sixteenth century; the psychological sense is much later. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: trait 来自法语 trait，上溯拉丁 tractus「划线、牵引」，出自 trahere「拉、拖」。英语在 16 世纪借入，心理学义则晚得多。年代均为约数。

items.en: Trahere meant 'to draw, drag, pull'. It is the source of tractor, traction, attract and contract, and its deeper origin is not established.
items.cn: trahere 意为「拉、拖、牵引」。它是 tractor、traction、attract、contract 的来源，更深来源未得到证明。

items.en: The noun meant 'a drawing, a line, a course, a pull'. The sense of a line drawn by the hand is the seed of the later meanings.
items.cn: 这个名词意为「划线、路线、牵引」。手画出的一条线这一义，是后来各义的种子。

items.en: French trait kept the sense of a stroke or line and extended it to a feature of the face and then of character.
items.cn: 法语 trait 保留了「一笔、一线」的意思，并把它延伸到面部特征，再延伸到性格特征。

items.en: English took the word in the sixteenth century, first for a stroke of the pen and soon for a feature of body or mind.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪借入这个词，先指一笔，很快指身体或心智上的一个特征。

items.en: Nineteenth- and twentieth-century psychology and genetics made trait a countable unit, so that people and organisms could be described feature by feature.
items.cn: 19 与 20 世纪的心理学与遗传学把 trait 变成可计数的单位，人与生物于是可以一条条特征来描述。

items.en: Source uncertain: the pre-Latin origin of trahere remains a reconstruction, and the first English use for character is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定：trahere 在拉丁语之前的来源属重构形式，英语中首次用于「性格特征」义的年代也未精确。

note.en: Group one holds look-alikes that belong to different histories; group two holds the near synonyms with different weight.
note.cn: 第一组是字形相近却来历不同的词；第二组是分量不同的近义词。

entries.definition: From Latin tradere 'to hand over' through French: a person who hands others over. It shares no root with this word despite the spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 经法语出自拉丁 tradere「交出」：指把别人交出去的人。尽管拼写相近，与本词不同源。

entries.definition: Same Latin noun, but English kept it for a stretch of land or a short pamphlet, a drawn-out area rather than a line.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个拉丁名词，但英语把它留作一片土地或一本小册子，指拉展开的区域而非一条线。

entries.definition: From the same verb of drawing: the mark left behind, which overlaps with the sense of a slight amount.
entries.definitionCN: 同出那个「拉、画」的动词：留下的痕迹，与「一丝」义重叠。

entries.definition: From the same verb through French: something drawn along in a line, later a line of carriages.
entries.definitionCN: 经法语同出那个动词：被拉成一列的东西，后指一列车厢。

entries.definition: A feature that typifies a group or thing; it is broader and less technical than trait.
entries.definitionCN: 使一个群体或事物显出典型性的特征；比 trait 更宽、更少专业味。

entries.definition: A quality ascribed to someone or something, often from outside; traits are meant to be internal and stable.
entries.definitionCN: 被归到某人某物名下的品质，常由外界赋予；特质则被设定为内在而稳定。

entries.definition: The ordinary word for any feature, without the claim of stability that trait carries.
entries.definitionCN: 指任何特征的普通词，不带 trait 那种稳定性的主张。

entries.definition: A behaviour repeated until it is automatic; it can be changed, while a trait is presented as part of the make-up.
entries.definitionCN: 重复到自动化的行为；习惯可以改，而特质被呈现为构成的一部分。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root verb means 'to draw', so a trait is literally a line drawn to mark something.
normal.cn: 词根动词意为「拉、画」，因此 trait 字面上就是为标记某物而画的一条线。

normal.en: The family runs trait, traits, trait theory, personality trait, character trait.
normal.cn: 同族说法包括 trait、traits、trait theory、personality trait、character trait。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: a genetic trait, a personality trait, a common trait.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：遗传性状、人格特质、共同特征。

normal.en: The same Latin noun also gave tract, trace and train, each keeping a different part of the image.
normal.cn: 同一个拉丁名词还给了 tract、trace、train，各保留了意象的不同部分。

normal.en: Genetics says dominant and recessive traits, which shows the countable unit clearly.
normal.cn: 遗传学说显性与隐性性状，这把可计数单位记得很清。

abstract.en: Picture a single pencil line on a face, enough to make it recognisable.
abstract.cn: 想象脸上一道铅笔线，就足以让人认出。

abstract.en: Picture a map where one added stroke redraws a border.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上添的一笔改变了边界。

abstract.en: Picture a thread pulled out of cloth that still carries the shape of the weave.
abstract.cn: 想象从布里抽出的一根线，仍带着织法的形状。

examples.en: Patience is the one trait the job actually requires.
examples.cn: 这份工作真正要求的唯一特质是耐心。

examples.en: The species shares a trait that lets it survive dry seasons.
examples.cn: 这个物种共有一种能让它熬过旱季的性状。

examples.en: There was not a trait of irony in her reply.
examples.cn: 她的回答里没有一丝讥讽。

dict_mnemonic.text: trait 读如「垂特」——特意垂下的一笔 → 特征、特质

root: 法语 trait，上溯拉丁 tractus「划线、牵引」，出自 trahere「拉、拖」；与表「背叛者」的词形近而不同源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one movement: a line is drawn by hand, and that line is then read as a distinguishing quality, as a property of things, as a slight trace, as a biological character, as repeated behaviour, as a group's mark and finally as a line of the face.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个动作展开：手画出一条线，这条线依次被读作区别性品质、事物的属性、一丝痕迹、生物性状、重复行为、群体的标记，最后是脸上的一道线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one pencil line drawn across a face, far off a mere outline, close up a deliberate mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：脸上画出的一道铅笔线，远看只是轮廓，近看才知道是刻意的标记。

branches.en: THE MARK AND ITS CARRIER: first a quality that separates people, then the same mark drawn on an object.
branches.cn: 标记与承载体：先是把人与人分开的品质，再是画在物件上的同一标记。

branches.en: THE THINNEST LINE: one stroke is also the smallest visible amount, which is how the word came to mean a trace.
branches.cn: 最细的一条线：一笔也是最小的可见量，这个词由此有了「一丝」。

branches.en: THE MARK MADE INHERITABLE: genetics borrows the unit and ties the mark to a body.
branches.cn: 标记变成可遗传之物：遗传学借走这个单位，把标记绑到身体上。

branches.en: REPETITION AND SCALE: the same mark is inferred from repeated acts, or drawn around a whole group.
branches.cn: 重复与尺度：同一标记或从重复行为推断，或被画在整个群体周围。

branches.en: BACK TO THE HAND: the literal stroke survives in maps and portraits, where the drawn line is the thing itself.
branches.cn: 回到那只手：字面的一笔活在地图与肖像里，那里画出的线就是事物本身。

intro.en: A Latin participle used as a noun, carried through French, with one family of words keeping the drawing sense and another keeping the pulling sense.
intro.cn: 一个拉丁分词被当作名词使用，经法语传来；词族里一部分保留「画线」义，另一部分保留「拉」义。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere 'to draw' gives tract, trace, train, traction and contract; the noun tractus gives the line sense that French turned into this word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 trahere「拉」衍生 tract、trace、train、traction、contract；名词 tractus 则提供「线」义，法语由此造出本词。

items.example: The verb supplies the act of drawing a line.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供「画线」的动作。

items.meaning: a drawing, a line, a pull
items.example: The noun supplies the visible result.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词提供可见的结果。

items.example: Interrupting is a trait his colleagues expect.
items.exampleCN: 打断别人是他同事预期的特点。

items.example: The study rates twelve traits.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究评估十二项特征。

items.meaning: the approach that explains people by stable traits
items.meaningCN: 用稳定特质解释人的理论
items.example: Trait theory underlies the questionnaire.
items.exampleCN: 特质理论是这份问卷的基础。

items.meaning: an area or a short essay
items.example: A tract of forest was set aside.
items.exampleCN: 一片林地被划了出来。

items.example: No trace of the letter remained.
items.exampleCN: 那封信没有留下任何痕迹。

items.example: The idea is drawn out into a line.
items.exampleCN: 这个意象被拉成一条线。

latinEntries.meaning: a drawing, a line, a course

definition_zh: 不论，不考虑，不受……影响（比日常同义说法更正式，多用于法律、技术与学术文本）
definition_en: without being affected or limited by a particular factor; a formal equivalent of regardless of
core_image: 一份合同压在两叠厚薄悬殊的账本上，印章对两叠一视同仁
scene: 审计员翻看两叠厚薄不一的账本，表示抽查范围不看账本大小。 The auditor applied the same check to every ledger, irrespective of its size.
sceneCN: 这里取「不受……影响」（第 2 个义项：后接名词，属正式语域）；句意为审计员对所有账本施加同样的检查，不论其厚薄。

pos.zh: 介词短语：不论、不受……影响（正式）
状语用法：不论……都……

collocations.zh: 不受任何其他条款限制

senses.title: Front-position concession in formal prose
senses.titleCN: 句首状语：不论……都……（正式书面）
senses.definition: placed at the start of a formal sentence to say that the outcome is unchanged by the named factor
senses.definitionCN: 置于正式句子的开头，表示所述因素不改变结果
senses.example: Irrespective of the outcome, the procedure must be recorded.
senses.exampleCN: 不论结果如何，程序都必须记录在案。
senses.why: Fronting the phrase turns it into a frame for the whole sentence, a habit borrowed from legal and scientific drafting.
senses.whyCN: 把这个短语提到句首，它就成了统摄全句的框架，这是法律与科学写作的习惯。

senses.title: A noun that carries no weight
senses.definition: used before a noun phrase to state that the factor does not affect the decision
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词短语前，说明该因素不影响决定
senses.example: The fee is fixed irrespective of income.
senses.exampleCN: 费用是固定的，不受收入影响。
senses.why: Of introduces the factor being neutralized; because the phrase is formal, it prefers abstract nouns such as income or rank.
senses.whyCN: 介词引出被中和的因素；由于语域正式，它更偏爱收入、级别这类抽象名词。

senses.title: An open yes-or-no condition
senses.titleCN: 后接是否从句：不论是否
senses.definition: used before a whether clause to cover both possible answers at once
senses.definitionCN: 用在是否从句前，把两种可能一并覆盖
senses.example: The policy holds irrespective of whether the applicant is resident.
senses.exampleCN: 不论申请人是否本地居民，政策都一样。
senses.why: Whether presents two branches, and the phrase declares that neither branch changes the rule.
senses.whyCN: 是否从句摆出两条分支，而这个短语宣称两条都不改变规则。

senses.title: An open wh-question
senses.titleCN: 后接疑问从句：不论怎样、不论什么
senses.definition: used before a clause with how, what or who to cancel every possible value
senses.definitionCN: 用在怎样、什么、谁引导的从句前，抵消一切可能取值
senses.example: The sample was treated alike irrespective of how it had been stored.
senses.exampleCN: 不论样品此前如何存放，处理方式都相同。
senses.why: A wh-clause supplies a range of values, and the phrase says the same treatment applies across the whole range.
senses.whyCN: 疑问从句给出一个取值范围，这个短语表示整个范围都适用同一处理。

senses.title: A trailing qualifier after the verb
senses.definition: placed at the end of a clause after the verb to add a condition that does not restrict the rule
senses.definitionCN: 置于从句末尾、动词之后，补充一个并不限制规则的条件
senses.example: The safety rule applies to all staff, irrespective of rank.
senses.exampleCN: 安全规则适用于全体员工，不论级别。
senses.why: In final position the phrase reads as an afterthought that widens the rule rather than narrowing it.
senses.whyCN: 放在句末时，这个短语像是补一句，把规则的范围放宽而不是收窄。

senses.title: Admitting a fact in formal style
senses.definition: used before the fact that to grant a fact while denying its effect
senses.definitionCN: 用在「事实是」之前，承认事实但否认其作用
senses.example: Irrespective of the fact that funding fell, the team completed the survey.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管经费减少，团队仍完成了调查。
senses.why: The fact that clause is the formal route for a full statement, because the bare phrase cannot take a clause on its own.
senses.whyCN: 「事实是」从句是表达完整命题的正式通道，因为光秃秃的短语本身不能直接接从句。

senses.title: Contract language that overrides other terms
senses.titleCN: 合同用语：不受其他条款限制
senses.definition: in legal drafting, used to deny that any other provision can limit the clause
senses.definitionCN: 在法律起草中，用来否认任何其他条款能限制本条
senses.example: Irrespective of any other provision, notice must be given in writing.
senses.exampleCN: 不受任何其他条款限制，通知必须以书面形式发出。
senses.why: Contracts need a phrase that switches off competing clauses, and this one does that without naming them.
senses.whyCN: 合同需要一个能关掉竞争条款的说法，这个短语不必点名就做到了。

senses.title: Statistical independence from a variable
senses.titleCN: 科研统计：不随……改变、独立于
senses.definition: in research writing, used to say that a trend or result does not vary with a measured variable
senses.definitionCN: 在科研写作中，表示某个趋势或结果不随被测变量而变化
senses.example: The trend was stable irrespective of sample size.
senses.exampleCN: 这一趋势不随样本量改变而改变。
senses.why: Technical writing uses the phrase where a statistician would say independent of, because it marks a variable that was checked and found irrelevant.
senses.whyCN: 技术写作在此用这个短语，相当于统计学家说的「独立于」，因为它标出一个已被检验、判定无关的变量。

intro.en: Irrespective joins the negative prefix ir- to respective, from Latin respectus, a looking back, built on respicere, re- back plus specere, to look. The Latin line is certain; the English phrase is modern.
intro.cn: irrespective 由否定前缀 ir- 加 respective 构成；respective 出自拉丁语 respectus「回望」，词根 respicere 为 re-「回」加 specere「看」。拉丁语线索确定，英语短语属近代。

items.en: Specere, to look, is the root of respect, spectacle and specimen.
items.cn: specere 意为「看」，是 respect、spectacle、specimen 的共同词根。

items.en: Respicere meant to look back at or take notice of, hence to have regard for.
items.cn: respicere 意为「回看、注意到」，由此引申为「顾及」。

items.en: The noun respectus named a looking back and, later, regard or esteem.
items.cn: 名词 respectus 本指回望，后来指顾及与尊敬。

items.en: The assimilated negative prefix ir- reverses the looking, giving the sense of not looking at a factor.
items.cn: 同化的否定前缀 ir- 把「看」反过来，产生「不看某因素」之义。

items.en: The phrase irrespective of appears in formal nineteenth-century prose; dates are approximate.
items.cn: 短语 irrespective of 在十九世纪的正式散文里出现，年代为约数。

note.en: The first group shares the same slot and register but comes from other roots; the second group holds formal ways of expressing concession or exemption.
note.cn: 第一组同样占名词前的正式位置，却来自别的词根；第二组是表达让步或豁免的正式说法。

entries.definition: The everyday equivalent; it belongs to the regard family and sounds less technical.
entries.definitionCN: 日常同义说法；属「看」的词族，听起来不那么技术化。

entries.definition: A British legal phrase meaning concerning or as regards, not a negation of the factor.
entries.definitionCN: 英式法律短语，意为「关于」，并非否定某因素。

entries.definition: It narrows the topic of a statement rather than cancelling a condition.
entries.definitionCN: 它限定陈述的话题，而不是取消某个条件。

entries.definition: It concedes a fact and still asserts the main clause.
entries.definitionCN: 它承认事实，同时仍主张主句内容。

entries.definition: A transparent phrase with the same force, common outside technical writing.
entries.definitionCN: 意思透明的同义说法，在技术文本之外常用。

entries.definition: The usual research phrasing when a measured variable does not affect the result.
entries.definitionCN: 研究写作中的常用说法，指被测变量不影响结果。

entries.definition: It sets up an irrelevant factor in conversation.
entries.definitionCN: 在口语中引出一个无关因素。

entries.definition: It compresses an open range into one word before a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 在名词前用一个词压缩整个取值范围。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin root, the real negation and the real register.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想用真实拉丁词根、真实否定前缀与真实语域。

normal.en: Specere is to look, so respect is a looking back, and the negative form is not looking at the factor.
normal.cn: 拉丁词根意为「看」，回看即顾及，否定形式就是不看那个因素。

normal.en: Ir- is the same negative prefix seen in irregular and irrelevant.
normal.cn: 这个否定前缀与另外两个否定词相同。

normal.en: It takes a noun or a whether clause, never a bare that clause.
normal.cn: 它接名词或是否从句，从不直接接陈述从句。

normal.en: Position matters: fronting frames the whole sentence, trailing position widens the rule.
normal.cn: 位置有讲究：提前统摄全句，后置放宽规则。

normal.en: Its neutral twin is the one people actually say at lunch.
normal.cn: 它中性的双胞胎才是人们午饭时真会说的那个。

abstract.en: Like a single lamp switched on over two piles of papers of very different height.
abstract.cn: 像一盏灯同时照亮两叠厚薄悬殊的文件。

abstract.en: Like a measuring rod that ignores the weight of what it measures.
abstract.cn: 像一把尺子，不管所称之物有多重。

abstract.en: Like a door that opens for every name on the list, with no line drawn through any of them.
abstract.cn: 像一扇门为名单上每个名字打开，没有一个被划掉。

examples.en: The same standard was applied to all suppliers irrespective of their size.
examples.cn: 对所有供应商都采用同一标准，不论其规模。

examples.en: Irrespective of how the data were collected, the conclusion held.
examples.cn: 不论数据是如何收集的，结论都成立。

examples.en: The clause operates irrespective of any later agreement between the parties.
examples.cn: 该条款不受双方之后任何协议的影响。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「伊瑞斯佩克提夫 奥夫」——名单上一个也不划掉：不论、不受影响

root: irrespective 由否定前缀 ir- 加 respective 构成；respective 出自拉丁语 respectus「回望」，词根 respicere 为 re-「回」加 specere「看」。因此本词字面是「不看某因素」，即「不论」。英语短语首见年代为约数。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses differ by position, complement and register: front and trailing placement, noun and whether and wh clauses, a fact clause, contract override, and statistical independence.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项按位置、搭配与语域区分：句首与句末、名词与是否及疑问从句、事实从句、合同凌驾条款、统计独立。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one seal pressed onto two ledgers of very different thickness.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一枚印章盖在两叠厚薄悬殊的账本上。

branches.en: THE FRAME: at the front, the phrase governs the whole sentence.
branches.cn: 框架：置于句首时统摄全句。

branches.en: THE NEUTRAL FACTOR: a noun is cancelled, whether in a fee rule or in a research variable.
branches.cn: 被中和的因素：无论在收费规则还是研究变量中，名词都被取消。

branches.en: THE OPEN CLAUSE: whether and wh questions extend the cancellation to every branch.

branches.cn: 后置与事实：句末限定放宽规则，事实从句公开让步。

branches.en: THE OVERRIDE: in contracts the phrase switches off competing clauses.
branches.cn: 凌驾：合同里这个短语关掉竞争条款。

intro.cn: 这个词由否定前缀、拉丁语「看」的动词与英语介词组成；拉丁核心清楚。

latinIntro.en: The Latin etymon is respicere, to look back, whose root specere also gives spectacle and specimen.

definition_zh: 刺激；激发；兴奋作用；（经济）刺激措施
definition_en: the act of arousing, exciting or increasing the activity of something
core_image: 一根细针轻触马腹，马向前迈步；同一画面旁边是一只被点亮的灯泡
scene: 这里指「刺激」。 Gentle electrical stimulation helped the injured nerve recover.
sceneCN: 这里 stimulation 是「对神经的电刺激」（第 4 个义项：用电流等方式激发神经或肌肉活动）；句意：温和的电刺激帮助受伤神经恢复。图中可辨识物件：电极、神经示意线、脉冲波形、恢复中的肌肉。

pos.zh: 刺激；激发；兴奋作用；（经济）刺激措施（指过程时多不可数，指多种刺激时可用复数 stimulations）

derivatives.zh: 刺激物；刺激因素（复数 stimuli）
令人振奋的；起刺激作用的
